full_judgment: "A registered document carries presumption of correctness of the endorsement made therein and that one who disputes the said presumption is under the law required to dislodge the correctness of the endorsement in the registered document. Exhibit 1 has been registered by the Munsif-Cum-Magistrate of Udaypur, Tripura State, India. Since defendant No.5 was disputing the genuineness of the registered document Exhibitl it was his duty to establish that there was nothing like Munsif; Magistrate, Official or Office in Udaypur in the Tripura State who was authorised to register irrevocable power of attorney. But the said defendant totally failed to bring on record any material where form it can be said Munsif/ Magistrate, Udaypur, Tripura State, India was not competent to register Exhibit 1. The fact is that exhibit 1 was revalidated and re-stamped by the Office of the Additional Deputy Commissioner (Revenue), Comilla. Official act has the presumption of correctness and that one who challenges or disputes that presumption of correctness is required to establish that by legal evidence."
